crossRefs.note: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first…
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
“I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first…

translations.web: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
translations.bsb: I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not yet ready for solid food. In fact, you are still not ready,
translations.kjv: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ➔ ye were ➔ not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
translations.asv: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for ye were not yet able to bear it: nay, not even now are ye able;
